headline: Petroperú Discovers Tenth Illegal Tap on Norperuano Oil Pipeline
summary: Peru's state oil firm Petroperú reported a tenth illegal pipeline breach since June on its Norperuano Pipeline in Lambayeque, leading to crude oil spills along rural roadways.
why: Petroperú operates critical crude transport infrastructure linking Amazonian production areas to Pacific export terminals.

impacts.name: Petroperú
impacts.why: Pipeline disruptions and cleanup efforts generate maintenance expenses and curtail oil throughput.
